topic.title: Reviewing Content
topic.shortdesc: As reviewers in a review task, Subject-Matter Experts can open shared documents, read them in context, and evaluate the content before adding feedback.

body.p: When you open a review task as a reviewer, you can read the shared content in the online editor. This helps you review the text in a structured environment instead of working with static files or email attachments.
Before you add feedback, it is often useful to read through the content first and understand its purpose, structure, and audience.

ul.li: Open the files included in the task.
Read the content in order or move directly to the sections that need attention.
Check wording, structure, accuracy, and completeness.
Look for issues that affect the intended audience.

section.title: Good review practice
section.p: Focus on clear, specific feedback. If you find a problem, explain what is wrong and, if possible, suggest a better wording or a concrete correction. This helps authors process the feedback faster.
